name: Call Recap
description: A short recap of any phone call with the points and promises that matter.
outline: Open with who was on the call and its purpose, if stated.
Summarize the main points in a handful of bullets.
List promises, commitments and deadlines, with who made them.
Close with the follow-ups that are still to do.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Main Points
- Invoice 1042 is paid

## Commitments
- Send the contract by Monday (Omar)
